Name: Alternative Isla
Author: omena007
Description:
This is my version of the NPC Isla greated by [size=3]PaperNautilus. Basically I tried to keep the original feeling of the sprites and portraits and added some details and redid the hair. Her eyes are a bit tired, maybe it's the dehydration? I personally don't want the characters to look perfectly pretty but to have personality and flaws.

The hair credit for the Spirits Eve bun goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/67968777]siamece![/url][/size]
